name: Renjouji Mai
source: The daughter of a family that once led one of the pre-war 'zaibatsu' mega-corporations of Japan.  She is currently the Captain of the Knights, and she wields a parrying dagger and rapier in matches.  She is an effective leader, but her sense of humor and tendency to persistently try to recruit people she thinks will be useful to the knighthood can be off-putting.  She is the head of the faction in the knighthood focused on reforming the system, which in the past has had a tendency toward corruption.
